headline: Optical and AI demand drive fastest growth yet
summary_short: Core sales grew 19% to $5.08B and core EPS grew 36% to $0.91, with core operating margin up 310bp to 22.7%. Corning guides Q4 core EPS to $0.96-$1.00.
summary_long: Optical Communications sales rose 44% to $2.38B, with Enterprise Networks up 84% and Gen AI products more than doubling. Solar grew 37% but ramped more slowly than expected. Core gross margin expanded 150bp to 40.5% and core ROIC 330bp to 16.7%. Corning secured four multibillion-dollar customer agreements, including with Verizon and AT&T. Q4 outlook: core sales of $5.2B-$5.3B, about 19% growth. Adjusted free cash flow for nine months was $2.27B.
confidence_notes: Core measures are non-GAAP; the difference from GAAP EPS reflects hedged exposures and discrete tax items per the release. Segments were recast in Q1 2026 (Glass Innovations, Solar), so prior-period segment figures are restated.

drivers.explanation: Optical Communications up 44% on Gen AI demand and Enterprise Networks up 84%, plus Solar up 37% as production ramped.
Core gross margin expanded 150bp and sales growth outpaced costs; release frames this as proof of the Springboard plan's growth acceleration.
Strong adjusted free cash flow while investing more than half a billion dollars in capital expenditures to meet demand.
CEO says content expansion in customer ecosystems and faster adoption of innovations help Corning outperform its underlying markets.
